sourceContext.revisionMeaning: Official context only; not asserted to be the exact deployed source revision.

usdcTransferPath.transferFrom: Requires unpaused; caller/from/to not blacklisted; value <= allowance. Calls exact-debit-and-credit _transfer; decrements allowance by value; returns bool true. No Approval is emitted by this deployed transferFrom, even for allowance decrement. No infinite-allowance special case.
usdcTransferPath.transfer: Requires unpaused and caller/to not blacklisted. Calls same _transfer; returns bool true.
usdcTransferPath._transfer: Requires nonzero from/to and sufficient balance. Exact requested value deducted from from and added to to via SafeMath; exactly one Transfer(from,to,value) emitted. No external receiver hook, fee deduction or rebase in this call path.
usdcTransferPath.balanceState: V2_2 uses low 255 bits for balance and high bit for blacklist. _setBalance rejects >2^255-1 and blacklisted addresses.
usdcTransferPath.administration: Only proxy admin can change proxy admin or upgrade implementation; token owner controls replacement pauser, blacklister and master minter. Pauser can pause/unpause; blacklister can blacklist/unblacklist. Public role addresses do not authenticate their controllers.
usdcTransferPath.signatureLibrary: 0x36939d5a1ca73901058f3fa2ba0b7546e7144d7a linked SignatureChecker is used by EIP2612/EIP3009 signature paths. Plain transfer and transferFrom do not reach it. Library implementation not independently authenticated in this limited path review.
usdcTransferPath.receiptExpectation: During ordinary direct USDC-input v3 swap, USDC callback transferFrom emits input Transfer from sender to pool. Proxy emits no independent event on fallback. WETH output/pool Swap assessment delegated to other investigation.

limitations: The policy was derived retrospectively only to exercise receipt-profile compatibility; it is not an independently predeclared policy or the proposed owner experiment.
RPC responses are provider-dependent observations, not consensus or state proofs.
Receipt event amounts remain subject to the unchanged plain-token assumption.
Reserve state is not established by receipt logs.
RPC responses are trusted observations, not Ethereum consensus or state proofs. Offline replay does not refresh canonicality or finality.
Financial checks compare receipt-emitted token amounts under a plain-token assumption. Arbitrary token logs can misrepresent balance changes; nonempty bytecode does not establish token semantics.
Hash-bound contract metadata and sender code are block-end observations, not proof of immediately-after-transaction wallet balances.
Pool price and tick fields are ABI- and range-checked only. The AMM price transition, liquidity accounting and execution quality are not independently simulated.
The supplied policy is retrospective; its original pre-transaction intent is not authenticated.
Receipt-scoped evidence cannot establish the input-token wallet reserve immediately after the target transaction.
